project: Aireplo Meta lead ad #01: The 2 AM sale

format.seconds_per_shot: varies, see each shot (generate 5s, or 10s where noted, and trim)

how_to_use: Generate each shot separately in Omni with its 'prompt' and 'negative_prompt'.
Paste the 'global_style' and the matching 'characters' text into every shot so people and colours stay consistent.
If Omni supports a reference image, generate shot 1 first and use its frame as the reference for the boutique owner in shots 3 to 5.
Do NOT add any text, captions, logos or app screens in Omni. Phone and laptop screens stay as a soft glow; the chat, captions, price card and logo are added afterwards as text animation.
Export each shot as MP4, 1080x1920, at the 'generate_length_seconds' length, named shot1.mp4 ... shot5.mp4. They are trimmed to 'duration_seconds' in the edit.
global_style: Cinematic vertical 9:16 video, shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural film grain, realistic skin tones, modern Indian setting, warm practical lighting with subtle emerald-green accents (#22C55E), clean premium commercial look like an Apple or Nykaa ad, smooth slow camera motion, no jump cuts inside the shot.

characters.owner: Priya, a 30-year-old Indian woman who owns a small ethnic-wear boutique, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, warm brown skin, small gold stud earrings, wears a mustard-yellow cotton kurta during the day and a soft grey t-shirt at night.
characters.customer: Ananya, a 24-year-old Indian woman, long straight black hair tied loosely, oversized cream hoodie, relaxed and cheerful.

negative_prompt_all: text, captions, subtitles, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, brand names, readable app interface, WhatsApp logo, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped faces, cartoon, 3D render, oversaturated, low resolution, flicker, fast shaky camera

shots.purpose: HOOK: stop the scroll. A phone lights up in a dark room at night.
shots.voiceover: This shop made a sale... at 2 AM.
shots.text_overlay_added_later: A sale at 2 AM… while the owner slept 😴 / clock 2:07 AM
shots.prompt: [global_style] Night, dark cosy Indian bedroom lit only by a dim blue moonlight from the window. Close-up of a smartphone lying face-up on a wooden bedside table. The phone screen suddenly lights up with a soft emerald-green glow and gently vibrates, casting green light on the table. In the soft-focus background, [owner] is fast asleep under a white blanket, turned away from camera, wearing a grey t-shirt. Slow push-in towards the glowing phone. Quiet, mysterious, intriguing mood.
shots.camera: slow dolly push-in, starts medium close-up, ends close-up on the phone

shots.purpose: PROOF: the customer gets an instant reply and buys.
shots.voiceover: Their WhatsApp AI answered the customer, shared the price, and sent the payment link. Automatically.
shots.text_overlay_added_later: WhatsApp chat animates on the phone: question → AI reply → Pay ₹1,299 → Payment received ✅
shots.prompt: [global_style] Night, a modern Indian apartment living room with warm fairy lights. [customer] sits cross-legged on a sofa, holding a smartphone in both hands at chest height, screen facing slightly towards the camera and glowing softly green with no visible content. She types a message, waits a second, then her face lights up with a delighted smile as she taps the screen to pay. Over-the-shoulder angle, then gentle arc to her face.
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder, slow arc from behind her shoulder to a three-quarter view of her smiling face
shots.negative_prompt: [negative_prompt_all], readable phone screen, visible chat bubbles

shots.purpose: PAYOFF: the owner wakes up to a sale she never had to answer.
shots.voiceover: She woke up to a new order she never had to reply to.
shots.text_overlay_added_later: New order ₹1,299 · Replied by AI in 3 sec
shots.prompt: [global_style] Early morning, golden sunrise light streaming through sheer curtains into the same bedroom. [owner] sits up in bed, picks up her phone from the bedside table, looks at the softly glowing screen, and breaks into a surprised, happy smile, raising her eyebrows. Warm, uplifting mood.
shots.camera: static medium shot at bed height, very slight handheld breathing movement

shots.purpose: SOLUTION: show the business running smoothly with the product.
shots.voiceover: Team inbox, broadcasts, and an AI agent in Hindi and English, all under your own brand.
shots.text_overlay_added_later: Feature chips: Team inbox · Broadcasts · AI agent · Your brand
shots.prompt: [global_style] Daytime inside a bright, stylish small Indian ethnic-wear boutique with colourful kurtas on wooden racks and potted plants. [owner], now in a mustard-yellow kurta, stands at the shop counter next to an open laptop whose screen glows softly green with no visible content, and confidently packs a folded blue kurta into a branded kraft-paper parcel. Busy but calm, successful small business.
shots.camera: slow lateral slide from left to right along the counter, medium shot

shots.voiceover: Just fifteen thousand rupees, one time. No monthly fee. Tap below for a free demo!
shots.text_overlay_added_later: ₹15,000 one-time · No monthly fee · +₹499 per extra feature · Live in 5 days · Tap 'Get quote' · Aireplo logo
shots.prompt: [global_style] Daytime at the boutique entrance. [owner] hands the kraft-paper parcel to a smiling delivery rider in a plain red jacket, then turns towards the camera with a confident, friendly smile and a small nod. Leave clean empty space in the upper half of the frame (soft-focus shop background) for a price card to be added later.
shots.camera: static medium shot, then subtle push-in on her smiling face in the last 2 seconds
shots.negative_prompt: [negative_prompt_all], delivery company logos, text on jacket
